title: Austin Briefings: Safety, Youth, Sustainability
summary:
*   City officials reviewed proposed agenda items for their upcoming September 5th meeting.
*   Presentations were given on public safety, youth, family, and neighborhood vitality, including input from Police Chief Elizabeth Watson.
*   The council received a briefing on the concept and initiatives related to building a sustainable community.
